entities.summary:
The Battle of Niḫriya was a pivotal clash between the Hittites and the Assyrians in Upper Mesopotamia, marking the culmination of their struggle for control over the remnants of the Mitanni empire in the second half of the 13th Century BC.

This decisive conflict had far-reaching consequences, reshaping the regional dynamics and paving the way for the rise of the New Hittite Empire.

The battle's outcome would significantly influence the course of the Late Bronze Age in the Near East, impacting the political landscape and the balance of power between rival powers.

As the dust settled, the legacy of the Battle of Niḫriya would be felt for generations to come, its impact still echoing through the annals of history.

The Hittite king, Suppiluliuma I, emerged victorious, his military prowess and strategic genius securing a lasting victory that would be remembered for centuries to come, 'The gods have given us the kingdom of Mitanni, and we shall not let it go.' - Suppiluliuma I
